Sedjem 0.3.0 updates itself, answers assistants such as Claude over MCP, keeps branches of a transcript, and
can tell speakers apart with NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Diarization. It also sends a few anonymous usage counts, which
can be turned off.

## Download

- Windows 10 and 11: `Sedjem-0.3.0-setup.exe` installs for your user, without admin rights. It isn't
  signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about an unknown publisher: choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
  Installing over 0.2.0 keeps your transcriptions, keys and models.
- Linux (x64): unpack `Sedjem-0.3.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` and run `Sedjem/Sedjem`.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` has the checksums of both.

0.2.0 can't update itself, so this one is installed by hand. From 0.3.0 on, Sedjem tells you when a newer
version is out and updates itself when you ask.

## Updates

- On first start Sedjem asks whether it may check GitHub once a day for a newer version. GitHub sees the
  computer's IP address; nothing else is sent. *Settings → Updates* changes this, and *Check now* always works.
- Two channels: *Stable* follows the releases, and *Latest* follows nightly previews of the newest changes that
  passed the tests on Windows and Linux.
- *Update now* runs the new installer on Windows, fast-forwards a git checkout and installs changed
  requirements, and unpacks the new Linux build next to the old one. Sedjem then starts again on the same port.

## Assistants

- Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code can list, search and read your transcriptions and courses over
  MCP, even while the app is closed. Prompts for summaries, minutes, study notes, quizzes and flashcards come with
  it.
- *Settings → Assistants* gives the snippet to connect each one, chooses what they may see, hides single
  transcriptions, and keeps a log of what they asked. Saving a corrected version from an assistant is off until
  you turn it on.

## Branches and a main transcript

- Start a new branch from any version of a transcription, and keep one main transcript for each recording. The
  *Branches* menu lists them, and the main one is marked.
- Assistants and scripts read the main transcript by default, and a save based on an old version is refused
  instead of overwriting newer work.

## Speaker labels

- The speaker model is chosen in *Settings → Models*: TitaNet-small (the default), TitaNet-large, 3D-Speaker
  CAM++ or NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Diarization. TitaNet-small is used until the chosen one is downloaded.
- Nemotron-3-Diarization finds who speaks when in one model and hears when two people talk at once. It put the
  fewest words on the wrong person on the test meetings and on two public sets, most clearly in meetings of four
  or more people, at about ten times the size of TitaNet-small and four to six times its time. Sedjem runs it with
  NumPy alone, with no PyTorch. The numbers are in
  [speaker labels](https://github.com/MohammedEl-sayedAhmed/sedjem/blob/main/docs/04-speaker-labels.md).

## Anonymous usage counts

- Sedjem now sends a few anonymous counts a month to Aptabase, in its EU region: the version, the system in broad
  terms, and how many transcriptions were made with which models. It never sends recordings, transcripts, names,
  file names, links or keys, and no identifier.
- The counts are on by default. The first start, or the first start after this update, says so and has their
  switch, and nothing is sent before that. The switch is also in *Settings → About*, and `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` or
  `SEDJEM_NO_USAGE=1` turns the counts off.
- Everything that is sent, and when, is listed in
  [usage counts](https://github.com/MohammedEl-sayedAhmed/sedjem/blob/main/docs/13-usage-counts.md).

## Fixes

- Windows: the server keeps a longer queue of connections, so a page no longer fails to load while the server is
  busy.
- Linux on Wayland: the app's window keeps Sedjem's icon in the taskbar.
- A model download that ends while *Settings* refreshes no longer shows as done before the model is ready.
- History: editing one line no longer marks other lines as changed because their speaker was stored one way in
  one version and another way in the next.
- Running from source on Windows: the PowerShell steps work (`.\app.cmd`), also with uv.

## Known limits

- The installer is unsigned, and macOS isn't built.
- On Linux, *Update now* unpacks the new build next to the old one rather than replacing it.
- Nemotron-3-Diarization hears at most 8 speakers.
